narratives.headline: 10-game Monday, five thin unders-and-overs props all at Pass conviction; the record is 9-15-0, so keep stakes small
narratives.briefing: It is a full 10-game slate with every game still to tip, but the board is thin: all five props sit at conviction 34 or 33, which the model itself grades as Pass. The clearest edges by sim are the Damian Lillard Under 7.5 reb+ast (sim 61% vs DraftKings 44%) and the Oso Ighodaro Under 7.5 points (sim 59% vs DraftKings 50%). Be plain about the record: the morning report is 9-15-0 for -6.96u, and game-line leans are 17-41 for -25.74u, so the five leans tonight are informational only. One positive is that morning picks have seen closing-line moves 15 toward and 7 against, which says the numbers are often getting better prices than the close. This edition is written before injury reports are final: we are waiting on Victor Wembanyama and De'Aaron Fox (both Questionable) and Collin Murray-Boyles (Day-To-Day), plus confirmation on the Probable tags for Jaylen Brown and Zion Williamson.

cards.p|4684272|pts|Under: With RJ Barrett out, Ja'Kobe Walter has still stayed under 12.5 in 7 of his last 10 and went 5 of 5 under against MIL, against a 12.1 projection. The risk is the Barrett absence itself: usage is +18% without him and he goes over when he plays long, so a minutes bump past his 31.3 projection or a Murray-Boyles absence would hurt; Kalshi at 44% also likes it less than DraftKings at 48%.
cards.p|4065778|pts|Under: Max Strus projects for 8.6 points against a 9.5 line, the Vegas team total sits below the model, and he has stayed under in 6 of his last 10. What makes it wrong is shot volume: he averaged 10.5 shots in the misses vs 6.6 in the hits, and the market has out-predicted the model on points this season, so this is a price play only at −110 or better.
cards.p|6606|ra|Under: This is the strongest sim edge on the board: Lillard goes under in 61% of simulated games, projects for 6.6, and has stayed under 7.5 in 7 of his last 10. Against it, he is 0 of 3 under 7.5 against PHI and comps lean +5% vs PHI; a Jaylen Brown change would also re-price it.
cards.p|5107173|tpm|Over: Danny Wolf is averaging 2.1 threes over his last 10 and projects for 1.9 against a 1.5 line, with Anthony Edwards out for MIN. The case against is real: MIN is the toughest of 30 on small-forward threes, he is 5 of 20 over on the road, and the market at 40% is betting against us.
cards.p|4601023|pts|Under: Oso Ighodaro is averaging 5.2 points over his last 10, has stayed under 7.5 in 8 of his last 10, and the sim has him under in 59% of games. He goes over when he plays long (27 minutes in the overs vs 22.3 otherwise), NO is a soft matchup for power forwards, and the margin is thin; watch Zion Williamson's status.

narratives.headline: Midday: one prop still holding, Danny Wolf Over 1.5 threes at +144, while four others drift past their play-to prices
narratives.briefing: Since the morning edition the board has churned hard: the morning's Max Strus, Damian Lillard, Oso Ighodaro and Ja'Kobe Walter unders were all removed as their prices moved, and Collin Gillespie came and went again at the 19:31Z run. The only card still Holding is Danny Wolf Over 1.5 threes, which has drifted from +134 at publish to +144, still inside the +149 play-to. Miles Bridges, Sandro Mamukelashvili, Coby White and Ryan Rollins are back on the board but every one is now past its play-to price (Bridges −125 vs −119, Mamukelashvili −128 vs −122, White −118 vs −112, Rollins −110 vs −105), so at current prices they are watch-only. Every remaining card is a Pass on conviction, and the record argues for restraint: morning picks are 10-19-0 (-10.19u) and finals 12-18-0 (-7.69u), though closing lines have moved toward the morning picks 19 times against 8. Before the 10 games tip, the open questions are Victor Wembanyama, De'Aaron Fox, Joel Embiid and Pascal Siakam, all Questionable; my searches found no fresh injury or lineup news on tonight's prop players beyond what the feeds already carry.

narratives.headline: Final: only Danny Wolf Over 1.5 threes still stands at its number; four other props are past their play-to lines
narratives.briefing: It is a 10-game slate with all 10 still to tip, and the late refresh mostly took plays off the board rather than adding them. Coby White and Jaden McDaniels came off at the last run, Joel Embiid moved from questionable to out, and Danny Wolf Over 1.5 threes is the only prop still holding inside its play-to line. Jaime Jaquez Jr., Dillon Brooks, Donovan Mitchell and Matas Buzelis are all on the board but past their play-to prices, so none of them should be added at tonight's number. The record argues for restraint: the final edition is 12-18-0 (-7.69u) and game-line leans are 17-41 (-25.74u). Still unresolved before tip are Victor Wembanyama and De'Aaron Fox (SA, questionable) and Pascal Siakam (IND, questionable); our searches found no newer reports than the brief's tags.
